{{Quote|That ''oil'' is extracted from the finest ''fish'' on this planet.|Governor Quarg|<ref name="MSW13" />}}
'''Fish oil''' was extracted from the [[Fish/Legends|fish]] of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drexel/Legends|Drexel]] by the [[Ship-dweller]]s under [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Quarg]]. Quarg gave [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] an [[Oil bath/Legends|oil bath]] in the stuff while they were stranded on Drexel, which C-3PO thought smelled strange.
